basis: renders a native <button> (implicit role button); while busy it swaps in a subordinate role="status" live region.

harness.because: button.e2e.ts pins the busy state's DOM-disabled aria-busy handshake and the icon variant's aria-label self-naming — click and attribute evidence; it exercises no keyboard interaction

exceptions.because: activation is the native <button>'s own Space/Enter contract and button.e2e.ts exercises no keyboard interaction; that floor is 3D's to build
